response.justification: Despite extensive experience, the candidate is overqualified and misaligned with the junior/mid-level role; their senior titles and deep expertise in DLang, embedded systems, and AI-agent infrastructure suggest they will be dissatisfied or underutilized, and their basic German proficiency conflicts with the high on-site requirement in Berlin.
strengths: Strong TypeScript and React experience across multiple roles
Proven full-stack development and system architecture skills
Active open-source contributions and technical teaching background
concerns: Senior-level title and experience far exceed junior/mid-level role expectations
Limited evidence of PostgreSQL or Nest.js experience (required)
Basic German language skills likely hinder on-site collaboration
